'''Jacek Marek Junosza Kisielewski'''<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|date=2008-02-15|title=DOU 15/02/2008 - Pg. 6 - Seção 1 {{!}} Diário Oficial da União {{!}} Diários Jusbrasil|url=https://www.jusbrasil.com.br/diarios/466121/pg-6-secao-1-diario-oficial-da-uniao-dou-de-15-02-2008|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210530110110/https://www.jusbrasil.com.br/diarios/466121/pg-6-secao-1-diario-oficial-da-uniao-dou-de-15-02-2008|archive-date=2021-05-30|access-date=2019-11-29|website=Jusbrasil|language=pt}}</ref> ({{IPA|pl|j'at͡sɛk m'arɛk jun'ɔʂa kʲiɕɛl'ɛfskʲi}}; born 21 January 1952, in [[Poznań]])<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://orka.sejm.gov.pl/Biuletyn.nsf/0/752B7F1C792983C0C1256B730036DA84?OpenDocument|title=Zapis przebiegu posiedzenia Komisji Łączności z Polakami za Granicą /nr 22/|date=1999-06-15|website=orka.sejm.gov.pl|language=pl|access-date=2019-11-29|archive-date=2023-04-11|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230411064153/http://orka.sejm.gov.pl/Biuletyn.nsf/0/752B7F1C792983C0C1256B730036DA84?OpenDocument|url-status=dead}}</ref> is a Polish biologist and diplomat; ambassador to [[Brazil]] (2007–2013) and [[Portugal]] (2016–2020).

== Life ==
Jacek Junosza Kisielewski studied Biology at the [[Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań]]. In 1978, he defended his [[doctoral thesis]], and, in 1990, [[Doctorate|post-doctoral degree]] ([[habilitation]]) on ''Inland-water [[Gastrotrich]]a from Brasil.''<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=10651&_k=lg7r4l|title=dr hab. Jacek Junosza-Kisielewski (Kisielewski)|website=nauka-polska.pl|language=pl|access-date=2019-11-29}}</ref> He was working as a biologist at the [[Siedlce University of Natural Sciences and Humanities|University of Agriculture and Pedagogy in Siedle]] and at the Research Centre for Agricultural and Forest Environment of [[Polish Academy of Sciences]] in Poznań. He was a visiting professor at the [[University of São Paulo]] (1984–1985). He has also been carrying out research at the [[Amazon River|Amazon delta]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://orka.sejm.gov.pl/Biuletyn.nsf/0/A2AFCEA4EF3C91ADC125735A0043D7D0?OpenDocument|title=Zapis przebiegu posiedzenia Komisji Spraw Zagranicznych /nr 90/|date=2007-08-23|website=orka.sejm.gov.pl|language=pl|access-date=2019-11-29}}</ref> He was doctoral advisor of one thesis (1992).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/research?id=81361&_k=ij8azk|title=Występowanie Gastrotricha w mule dennym zbiorników słodkowodnych|website=nauka-polska.pl|language=pl|access-date=2019-11-29}}</ref>

In 1991, he joined the [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Poland)|Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Poland]]. Between 1991 and 1996, he served at the Consulate General in Brussels, since 1992 as [[Consul-General]].<ref>{{Cite journal|title=Rocznik Polskiej Polityki Zagranicznej|journal=Yearbook of Polish Foreign Policy|publisher=[[Polish Institute of International Affairs|Polski Instytut Spraw Międzynarodowych]]|year=1996|editor-last=Wizimirska|editor-first=Barbara|location=Warszawa|pages=282|language=pl|issn=1230-4794}}</ref> Later, he was working at the MFA Consular Department, and as director of the Department for Cooperation with Polish Diaspora. From 1999 to 2004, he was Consul-General in [[Toronto]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|date=2016-06-08|title=Zapis przebiegu posiedzenia Komisji Spraw Zagranicznych /nr 29/|url=http://www.sejm.gov.pl/sejm8.nsf/biuletyn.xsp?documentId=9AB0B87CBF867122C1257FD400488E44|access-date=2019-11-29|website=sejm.gov.pl|language=pl}}</ref> Following his directoral post at the Consular Department, he was nominated Poland ambassador to Brazil, presenting his [[letter of credence]] on 13 February 2008.<ref name=":0" /> He ended his term in 2013. Afterwards, he was back at the Department for Cooperation with Polish Diaspora and Poles Abroad, since 2014 as a director.<ref name=":1" /> In August 2016, he was nominated Poland ambassador to [[Portugal]],<ref>{{Cite web|date=2016-08-02|title=MSZ: nominacje dla ambasadorów RP w Wielkiej Brytanii, Portugalii, Albanii i Serbii - ludzie|url=https://www.wnp.pl/parlamentarny/ludzie/msz-nominacje-dla-ambasadorow-rp-w-wielkiej-brytanii-portugalii-albanii-i-serbii,12577.html|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210530105729/https://www.wnp.pl/parlamentarny/ludzie/msz-nominacje-dla-ambasadorow-rp-w-wielkiej-brytanii-portugalii-albanii-i-serbii,12577.html|archive-date=2021-05-30|access-date=2019-11-29|website=wnp.pl|language=pl}}</ref> accredited to the [[President of Portugal|president]] [[Marcelo Rebelo de Sousa]] on 19 October 2016.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2016-10-19|title=Presidente da República recebeu credenciais de novos Embaixadores em Portugal|url=http://www.presidencia.pt/?idc=10&idi=116365|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170103122743/http://www.presidencia.pt/?idc=10&idi=116365|archive-date=2017-01-03|access-date=2019-11-29|website=presidencia.pt|language=pt}}</ref> He ended his term on 14 August 2020.<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=11 August 2020|title=Postanowienie Prezydenta Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej z dnia 11 sierpnia 2020 r. nr 110.36.2020 w sprawie odwołania Ambasadora Rzeczypospolitej Polskiej|url=http://isap.sejm.gov.pl/isap.nsf/DocDetails.xsp?id=WMP20200000785|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2021-01-20|website=isap.sejm.gov.pl|language=pl}}</ref>

Besides [[Polish language|Polish]], Junosza Kisielewski speaks [[English language|English]], [[French language|French]], and [[Portuguese language|Portuguese]].<ref name=":2">{{Cite web|url=https://lizbona.msz.gov.pl/pl/ambasada/ambasador/|title=Ambasador Jacek Junosza Kisielewski|date=2018-02-20|website=lizbona.msz.gov.pl|language=pl|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180220045601/https://lizbona.msz.gov.pl/pl/ambasada/ambasador/|archive-date=2018-02-20|access-date=2019-11-29}}</ref> He is married to Grażyna Junosza Kisielewska,<ref>{{Cite web|date=May 2019|title=Corpo Diplomático Acreditado em Lisboa|url=https://www.portaldiplomatico.mne.gov.pt/images/pdf/Protocolo-estado/LivroCorpoDiplomatico-maio2019rev.pdf|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210215024258/https://www.portaldiplomatico.mne.gov.pt/images/pdf/Protocolo-estado/LivroCorpoDiplomatico-maio2019rev.pdf|archive-date=2021-02-15|access-date=2019-11-29|website=portaldiplomatico.mne.gov.pt|page=164|language=pt}}</ref> with a daughter.<ref name=":2" /> In his free time, he photographs nature.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://jjknatura.com/en/author|title=The Author - JJK Natura - Wildlife photography|website=jjknatura.com|access-date=2019-11-29}}</ref>
